tweets.text:
FOMC interest rate decision will happen today at 2PM ET.

91% odds of a rate pause, so it has pretty much priced in.

At 2:30PM ET, Kevin Warsh's press conference will start, which is the most important one.

Since the last FOMC meeting, both CPI and PPI have spiked higher, which means the inflation problem is getting worse.

If Warsh hints at more future rate hikes, markets could selloff hard.

And if he hints at a rate pause, BTC could tap the $82K-$82.5K zone.

tweets.text:
$BTC Starting to move higher as shorts are closing out or getting squeezed.

Like I said, a lot of derisking and uncertainty has happened already into this week. If nothing happens then the base case is a grind higher I think.

But we're yet yet to see a lot of events unfold. FOMC today, tech earnings still ongoing with the biggest names yet to come.

And of course midterms next week too.

But in all this chaos and uncertainty, let the chart lead. It often tells more than any headline would ever do.

quote.text:
$BTC Another day sitting at the $80K support.

Neither bull or bear seems to be able to get this market moving in any direction at this point.

I do stand by my point of yesterday. Even in a non ideal outcome of all the upcoming events, once they are done with, the market has certainty which helps the bulls more than the bears.

So if the bears want to see lower levels, it should happen sooner than later for that scenario to play out in my opinion.

The more selling gets absorbed down here during all this uncertainty without a breakdown, the more likely it is that we'll see seller exhaustion at some point and the market just starts grinding higher.
